skill.summary: Full Confluence Cloud REST API v2 skill (pages, spaces, folders, databases, whiteboards, comments, labels, tasks, properties, etc.) with basic/OAuth auth, pagination, and migration from confluence-cli.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of full Confluence Cloud REST API v2 skill.
- Supports all major API groups: pages, spaces, folders, whiteboards, databases, comments, tasks, and more.
- Compatible with both Basic (email + API token) and OAuth authentication methods.
- Includes helpers for pagination, admin key header, and easy migration from confluence-cli configurations.
- Provides command-line scripts for listing, retrieving, and calling endpoints directly.
